correction-action-causal-compiler.finding: The deployment failure is real, and the proposal survives narrowly as a standalone method thesis. DoVer, CausalFlow, and REFLECT already use controlled interventions to validate failure attributions, while ANNEAL persistently commits typed repairs. The surviving contribution is not causal repair itself, but learning minimal conjunctions of typed correction actions and compiling them into applicability-bounded programs that remain useful on unseen mixed failures after freezing. A retrieved library of individually validated repairs is the main threat, so compositional transfer rather than in-domain recovery must carry the paper.
correction-action-causal-compiler.finding_zh: 该部署失效是真实的，且该方案可以较窄地作为独立方法论文成立。DoVer、CausalFlow 和 REFLECT 已使用受控干预验证失败归因，ANNEAL 也会持久提交类型化修复。因此，剩余贡献不能只是因果修复本身，而应是学习类型化纠正动作的最小组合，并将其编译为具有适用范围的程序，使其冻结后仍能处理未见过的混合故障。最大的威胁是检索已有验证修复的简单程序库，因此论文必须由组合泛化而非域内恢复结果支撑。
correction-action-causal-compiler.required_action: Run a matched-budget factorial pilot with disjoint failure-composition and domain splits, comparing the compiler against intervention-based repair plus retrieval of validated corrections.
correction-action-causal-compiler.required_action_zh: 开展预算匹配的析因实验，严格划分故障组合与领域，并将编译器和“干预式修复加已验证纠正检索”基线直接比较。

counterfactual-rubric-rewrite.finding: The problem is real, but the present composition sits directly inside an already crowded mechanism boundary. CROME supplies causal and neutral rubric interventions, RRD decomposes, filters, and reweights rubric criteria, and PReMISE discovers, audits, and repairs reusable rubrics. Applying a sparse add/delete/reweight optimizer to those signals does not yet identify a new learning operator; a CROME-augmented RRD or PReMISE baseline can reproduce the proposed behavior. The idea becomes defensible only if each intervention estimates an identifiable rubric-atom effect and a formally constrained solver edits an existing deployed rubric with guarantees or empirically unique neutral-dimension preservation.
counterfactual-rubric-rewrite.finding_zh: 该问题是真实的，但当前组合直接落在已经十分拥挤的方法边界内。CROME 已提供因果与中性 rubric 干预，RRD 已进行准则分解、过滤和重加权，PReMISE 已发现、审计并修复可复用 rubric。仅对这些信号应用稀疏的增删与重加权优化器，尚未形成新的学习算子；加入 CROME 数据的 RRD 或 PReMISE 基线即可复现其行为。只有当每个干预都能估计可识别的 rubric 原子效应，并由形式化约束求解器修改已有部署 rubric，同时提供保证或独有的中性维度保持能力时，该想法才足以成立。
counterfactual-rubric-rewrite.required_action: Replace generic minimal rewriting with an intervention-effect matrix and an explicitly constrained sparse edit solver, then compare it against CROME-augmented RRD and PReMISE.
counterfactual-rubric-rewrite.required_action_zh: 将通用的最小重写改为“干预效应矩阵加显式约束的稀疏编辑求解器”，并与使用 CROME 干预数据的 RRD 和 PReMISE 比较。

memory-interaction-clause-learner.finding: The failure is deployment-relevant, and the proposal identifies a behavior-changing persistent object that is not directly covered by current memory systems. ActMem reasons over causal memory graphs, RSCB-MC gates risky memory use, and HGMem represents higher-order memory relations, but none of these official descriptions learns reusable compatibility, exclusion, and precedence clauses from controlled co-retrieval interventions and tests them on unseen memory combinations. The thesis survives only at the type-level compositional boundary: if clauses merely memorize memory identities, a contextual gate or association-rule learner erases the contribution.
memory-interaction-clause-learner.finding_zh: 该失效具有真实部署意义，而且方案提出了一个能够持续改变行为、尚未被现有记忆系统直接覆盖的更新对象。ActMem 在因果记忆图上推理，RSCB-MC 对高风险记忆使用进行门控，HGMem 表示高阶记忆关系，但这些官方方法描述均未通过受控共同检索干预，学习可复用的兼容、排斥与优先级条款，并在未见过的记忆组合上测试。该论文只能依靠类型层面的组合泛化成立；如果条款只是记住具体记忆身份，情境门控器或关联规则学习器就会消除其贡献。
memory-interaction-clause-learner.required_action: Use disjoint memory-identity and composition splits to demonstrate that typed clauses outperform a capacity-matched pairwise or contextual risk gate on unseen pairs and triples.
memory-interaction-clause-learner.required_action_zh: 使用记忆身份与组合均不重叠的数据划分，证明类型化条款在未见过的二元和三元组合上优于容量匹配的成对或情境风险门控器。

minimal-stabilizing-patch-search.finding: The regression problem is real, but the proposed method is generic constrained optimization rather than an identifiable new learning mechanism. HarnessFix already generates scoped patches with regression-aware validation, ANNEAL commits constrained typed patches with canary testing and rollback, and GEPA or ProTeGi searches prompt edits from failure feedback. Freezing the first update and attaching the smallest accepted second patch does not create a new operator: jointly re-optimizing the original update against target and regression losses under the same grammar, edit budget, and call budget is an equivalent and usually simpler baseline. This should remain a repair component unless the patch becomes a learned update-conditioned inverse operator that transfers across update instances.
minimal-stabilizing-patch-search.finding_zh: 回归问题是真实的，但所提方法本质上是通用受约束优化，而不是可识别的新学习机制。HarnessFix 已生成带回归验证的局部补丁，ANNEAL 已通过金丝雀测试和回滚提交受约束的类型化补丁，GEPA 或 ProTeGi 也会根据失败反馈搜索提示词编辑。冻结第一次更新并附加最小的第二补丁，并不会形成新算子：在相同语法、编辑预算和调用预算下，针对目标收益与回归损失联合重新优化原始更新，是等价且通常更简单的基线。除非补丁被改为能够跨更新实例迁移的、以原更新为条件的逆算子，否则该方案应仅作为修复组件。
minimal-stabilizing-patch-search.required_action: Replace per-instance patch search with a learned update-conditioned inverse or residual operator and demonstrate transfer to unseen update commits against matched joint re-optimization.
minimal-stabilizing-patch-search.required_action_zh: 将逐实例补丁搜索改为可学习的、以原更新为条件的逆向或残差算子，并在未见过的更新提交上相对预算匹配的联合重优化证明迁移能力。

probe-mutation-retirement-policy.finding: The problem is real and the proposal has a defensible standalone boundary: prior work separately studies test relevance decay, mutation-guided test augmentation, and adaptive item selection, but not a fixed-budget, lineage-aware keep/mutate/merge/retire operator optimized for future regressions across version streams. The persistent portfolio is behavior-changing after freezing, and future-regression recall can provide independent temporal supervision. The main risk is that explicit half-life and mutation may collapse to a future-hit predictor plus diversity-constrained top-k selection.
probe-mutation-retirement-policy.finding_zh: 该问题真实存在，且方案具有可辩护的独立边界：既有工作分别研究测试相关性衰减、基于变异的测试增强和自适应题目选择，但尚未形成一个在固定预算下、利用谱系信息并针对跨版本未来回归进行优化的保留、变异、合并和淘汰算子。冻结后的持久化探针组合会改变后续测试行为，未来回归召回率也可提供独立的时间监督。主要风险是显式半衰期和探针变异最终可能退化为未来命中率预测器加多样性约束的 top-k 选择。
probe-mutation-retirement-policy.required_action: Run a prequential version-stream study with a capacity-matched no-mutation value predictor and require mutation to improve the future-recall versus execution-cost Pareto frontier while preserving each probe's original semantic boundary.
probe-mutation-retirement-policy.required_action_zh: 开展按版本顺序的前瞻评测，加入容量匹配且不进行变异的价值预测基线，并要求探针变异在保持原始语义边界的同时改进未来召回率与执行成本的帕累托前沿。

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A lineage-preserving, fixed-budget portfolio policy that mutates probes before retirement and is trained on temporally held-out regression value rather than static difficulty or current-suite adequacy.

probe-mutation-retirement-policy.strongest_baseline: Capacity-matched future-hit prediction plus submodular diversity selection under the same probe-generation and execution budget.
probe-mutation-retirement-policy.decisive_pilot: On two chronological version streams, freeze the policy at each round and compare full keep/mutate/merge/retire control against no-mutation learned selection, long-standing-probe selection, IRT, random mutation, and keep-all using identical total probes and generation calls.
probe-mutation-retirement-policy.stop_rule: Stop the standalone combination claim if the no-mutation learned selector matches future-regression recall within a predeclared equivalence margin at equal cost, or if more than 10% of retained mutations fail independent semantic-boundary validation.
unknowns: No official source verifies that the proposed multi-round version logs include an independent full-suite oracle for future regressions.

combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A learned future-regression-hit predictor followed by diversity-constrained top-k probe selection, with no mutation or explicit retirement policy.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Mostly closed: version diffs and historical outcomes sense decay, future held-out regressions assign credit, and the portfolio update persists into later versions; semantic validation of mutations is the remaining weak link.

update-composition-repair-compiler.finding: The proposal targets a real failure that rollback-only update management does not solve, and its surviving thesis is preservation-aware repair of incompatible, independently versioned prompt, memory, skill, and workflow updates. Existing workflow optimizers localize and patch failures, and reversible-trace systems accelerate counterfactual repair, but they do not learn reusable compatibility clauses and compile minimal bridges or reorderings that maximize retained updates on unseen compositions. The thesis survives only if clause induction generalizes beyond enumerating the small repair search space.
update-composition-repair-compiler.finding_zh: 该方案针对的是真实故障：仅回滚更新无法解决多个独立版本化的提示、记忆、技能和工作流更新之间的不兼容。现有工作流优化器可以定位并修补故障，可逆轨迹系统也能加速反事实修复，但它们并未学习可复用的兼容性子句，并在未见组合上编译最小桥接或重排序补丁以最大化保留更新数量。只有当兼容性子句能够超越小规模修复空间的枚举搜索并实现泛化时，该论文主张才成立。
update-composition-repair-compiler.required_action: Hold out entire incompatibility templates and update-surface combinations, then show that learned clauses compile successful minimal repairs with higher retained-update utility and lower oracle calls than an equally expressive constrained graph-search baseline.
update-composition-repair-compiler.required_action_zh: 完整留出不兼容模板和更新表面组合，并证明学习到的子句相较于同等表达能力的约束图搜索基线，能够用更少的判定调用编译出成功的最小修复，同时保留更多更新效用。

api-semantic-workflow-compiler.strongest_baseline: Capacity-matched direct schema-to-schema LLM rewriting with execution-guided repair and the same behavioral verifier.

api-semantic-workflow-compiler.stop_rule: Stop if frozen-IR transfer does not exceed direct verified rewriting by the predeclared margin on both end-task success and recovery-branch equivalence, or if equivalence holds only after target-family fine-tuning.
unknowns: The proposed three equivalent API families and their independent semantic-equivalence specifications are not identified.
ToolBench does not by itself provide proven equivalence classes, precondition/effect annotations, or recovery-semantics oracles for this pilot.

removable_atoms: canonical tool semantics as a separate atom, because it can be folded into the workflow IR
a learned compiler, if direct constrained rewriting with execution verification matches frozen-IR transfer
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Direct LLM workflow rewriting against the target schema followed by execution-guided repair and behavioral regression tests, with the same model calls.
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Incomplete as written: traces sense API behavior and execution can evaluate outputs, but the credit assignment and update rule for inducing reusable semantics are unspecified; future evaluation is coherent only with an independent equivalence and recovery oracle.

cross-model-memory-translation-operator.finding: The model-swap problem is real and the translator is a persistent object, but the stated method is not yet distinguishable from cross-model prompt transfer. PromptBridge already learns a mapping from source-model prompts to target-model prompts using calibrated source-target pairs and evaluates transfer to unseen tasks. Because the proposed memories are natural-language assets, renaming prompts as memories, adding generic behavior anchors, and imposing cycle consistency does not establish a new learning operator. Equal-budget target-model rewriting or PromptBridge can plausibly reproduce the claimed behavior.
cross-model-memory-translation-operator.finding_zh: 模型切换导致资产失效是真实问题，翻译器也是持久化对象，但当前方法尚无法与跨模型提示迁移区分。PromptBridge 已利用源模型与目标模型的校准提示对学习映射，并在未见任务上迁移。由于这里的记忆仍是自然语言资产，把提示改称记忆、增加通用行为锚点和循环一致性，并不能形成新的学习算子；等预算的目标模型重写或 PromptBridge 很可能复现其效果。
cross-model-memory-translation-operator.required_action: Redefine the learned object as a composition-aware translator over typed procedural memories, retrieval links, and execution constraints rather than plain text, and require superiority to equal-budget PromptBridge and target-model rewriting on held-out target families.
cross-model-memory-translation-operator.required_action_zh: 将学习对象实质性改为面向类型化程序记忆、检索链接和执行约束的组合感知翻译器，而非纯文本映射，并要求其在未见目标模型家族上超过等预算的 PromptBridge 和目标模型直接重写。

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is deployment on persistent agent memories with anchor preservation, but no method-level distinction survives while those memories are represented and translated as ordinary natural-language prompts.

cross-model-memory-translation-operator.strongest_baseline: PromptBridge plus per-memory target-model rewriting using exactly the same target-model calls and anchor tasks
cross-model-memory-translation-operator.decisive_pilot: Train on two source-target model-family pairs and typed memory categories, then freeze all methods and evaluate on a held-out target family with matched target calls, memory tokens, and optimization examples; compare direct copy, semantic rewriting, PromptBridge, per-memory target rewriting, and the proposed translator on task utility, negative transfer, and anchor preservation.
cross-model-memory-translation-operator.stop_rule: Block the translator thesis if PromptBridge or independent target rewriting matches its held-out utility and anchor preservation within the preregistered confidence interval, or if removing cycle consistency does not materially change transfer.
unknowns: Whether a memory contains structure beyond text that PromptBridge cannot represent
How source-target training pairs are obtained without per-target optimization equivalent to the rewriting baseline
Whether anchor tasks are independent of translator training and representative of future memory use
Whether translation to a genuinely unseen target family is possible without target-family calibration

removable_atoms: cycle consistency, because direct target-behavior optimization can train the same source-to-target mapping
canonical behavior anchors as a distinct atom, because they function as ordinary calibration or validation tasks unless tied to structured memory semantics
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: PromptBridge trained on the same source-target behavior pairs, followed by equal-budget target-model rewriting of each memory
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposal senses cross-model behavior gaps, updates a translator, and evaluates frozen translations, but it does not close a memory-specific loop beyond existing prompt calibration and transfer.

evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.finding: Evaluator co-adaptation is a real failure and independent anchors can provide identifiable supervision, but the current composition is close to static judge calibration. Bridge already models latent target judgments and systematic judge deviations, SAJA trains a lightweight calibration head from external labels, and CREAM regularizes reward consistency across self-rewarding iterations. The proposed factorization becomes a standalone method only if crossed actor-evaluator histories reveal future-version bias that a capacity-matched static calibration head cannot predict.
evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.finding_zh: 评估器随演员共同适应是真实失效，独立锚点也能提供可识别监督，但当前组合与静态评估器校准非常接近。Bridge 已建模潜在真实判断及评估器系统偏差，SAJA 使用外部标签训练轻量校准头，CREAM 则约束多轮自奖励中的评分一致性。只有当演员与评估器版本的交叉历史能够预测静态校准头无法预测的未来版本偏差时，该方法才构成独立论文。
evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.required_action: Use a fully crossed actor-version by evaluator-version design and constrain the residual head to predict held-out future evaluator bias beyond a capacity-matched Bridge or SAJA-style static calibrator.
evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.required_action_zh: 采用完整的演员版本乘评估器版本交叉设计，并要求残差头在预测未见未来评估器偏差时显著超过容量匹配的 Bridge 或 SAJA 式静态校准器。

closest_work.title: Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap
SAJA: A Simple Approach to Judge Alignment for LLM-as-a-Judge
CREAM: Consistency Regularized Self-Rewarding Language Models

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The potentially new boundary is correction of evaluator drift from a longitudinal, crossed actor-evaluator matrix with prospective evaluation on future co-evolution rounds and downstream policy selection.

evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched static calibration head trained on the identical anchor judgments and score features, with no cross-version factorization
evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.decisive_pilot: Create at least eight actor versions and eight evaluator versions, score every actor with every evaluator on fixed independent anchors, train through round five, and predict rounds six through eight with identical evaluator calls; compare frozen judges, ensembles, Bridge, SAJA-style calibration, an item-response model, and the residual corrector on ranking error and independently verified quality of the selected policy.
evaluator-anchor-residual-corrector.stop_rule: Reduce the work to evaluator calibration if a static calibrator matches future-round ranking accuracy, the latent factors are unstable across random seeds, or improved anchor fit does not improve independently verified policy selection.
unknowns: Whether the actor-evaluator score matrix will be dense enough for identifiable factorization
Whether the external verifier is genuinely independent of the evolving actors and evaluators
Which features and parameters are available to the residual head
Whether future evaluator versions differ through genuine bias drift rather than ordinary capability improvement

removable_atoms: cross-version score factorization if a direct calibration head trained on the same anchors produces equivalent future rankings
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A SAJA-style calibration head or Bridge regression fitted directly to the same independent anchor labels without actor-ability and evaluator-bias factorization
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Independent anchors, persistent correction, and future policy-selection evaluation can form a loop, but actor ability, task difficulty, and evaluator bias are not identifiable unless actor and evaluator versions are sufficiently crossed.

retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.finding: The problem is real and the proposed loop extends beyond existing causal memory selection by attempting pathway-specific persistent repair. However, randomizing only retrieval exposure identifies an inclusion effect, not separate direct content, retrieval-position, and co-memory interaction effects. MemAudit already performs counterfactual causal attribution, Causal Memory Intervention selects or suppresses memories through controlled interventions, and Memory Worth exposes retrieval-outcome and co-retrieval confounding. A factorial intervention design and a direct repair-policy baseline are required before causal mediation is an identifiable and necessary mechanism.
retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.finding_zh: 该问题真实存在，而且方案试图把因果分析进一步编译为针对不同伤害路径的持久化修复，边界比现有因果记忆选择更强。但仅随机化是否检索，只能识别记忆纳入效应，无法分别识别内容直接效应、检索位置效应和多记忆交互效应。MemAudit 已进行反事实因果归因，Causal Memory Intervention 已通过受控干预选择或抑制记忆，Memory Worth 也揭示了检索结果关联及共同检索混杂。因此必须加入析因干预和直接修复策略基线，才能证明因果中介既可识别又不可替代。
retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.required_action: Replace single exposure randomization with a preregistered factorial intervention over inclusion, content substitution, rank or position, and co-retrieval, and compare the resulting decomposer against a direct contextual repair bandit trained from the same interventions.
retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.required_action_zh: 将单一的检索暴露随机化替换为预注册析因干预，分别操纵是否纳入、内容替换、排序或位置以及共同检索，并使用相同干预数据与直接学习修复动作的上下文多臂老虎机比较。

closest_work.title: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection
When to Forget: A Memory Governance Primitive

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The surviving boundary is identification of distinct content, retrieval, position, and co-memory pathways followed by pathway-specific persistent rewriting or retrieval constraints under independent environment rewards.

retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.strongest_baseline: A matched-data contextual repair bandit that directly chooses keep, delete, rewrite, down-weight, or mutual exclusion from randomized outcome logs
retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.decisive_pilot: For chronological tasks, independently randomize memory inclusion, rank, content-preserving versus semantic-changing rewrites, and co-retrieval partners; train on the first stream segment, freeze all repairs, and compare mediation-guided repair, direct repair bandits, causal selection, uniform deletion, and fixed down-weighting on future tasks with identical retrieval and interaction budgets.
retrieval-mediated-memory-harm-decompose.stop_rule: Demote the proposal to an analysis tool if pathway effects are not identifiable with stable signs across two model families, if the inferred pathway does not predict the best repair action, or if the direct repair bandit matches frozen future-task utility.
unknowns: The causal graph and formal definitions of direct, retrieval-mediated, positional, and interaction effects
Whether sequential interference and adaptive retrieval violate the required mediation assumptions
How sufficient positivity will be maintained for rare memories and co-retrieval combinations
Whether ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite provide reward signals granular and independent enough for entry-level causal attribution

removable_atoms: causal mediation if a direct contextual policy can choose deletion, rewriting, down-weighting, or exclusion from the same randomized outcomes with equal performance
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Per-memory randomized ablation with a contextual bandit that directly selects the best repair action without estimating mediation pathways
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Randomized sensing, independent task reward, persistent memory and retrieval updates, and frozen future evaluation could close the loop, but the currently stated exposure intervention does not identify the claimed direct, mediated, positional, and interaction components.

simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.finding: The deployment problem is real and simulator-off evaluation correctly separates persistent learning from online planning, but the proposed mechanism is already covered by counterexample-guided safety-rule synthesis and runtime specification enforcement. AutoSpec mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, induces discriminative predicates, edits symbolic rules, and verifies candidate revisions; AgentSpec provides executable trigger-predicate-enforcement rules for runtime agent safety. Generating the training counterexamples with a simulator and freezing the resulting rule library changes the data source and deployment boundary, not the underlying learning operator.
simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.finding_zh: 部署问题真实存在，而且关闭模拟器后的评测能够正确区分持久学习与在线规划；但所述机制已被反例引导的安全规则合成和运行时规范执行覆盖。AutoSpec 会挖掘假阳性和假阴性反例、归纳区分谓词、修改符号规则并验证候选版本；AgentSpec 则提供可执行的触发器、谓词和执行规则。使用模拟器生成训练反例并冻结规则库，只改变数据来源和部署边界，没有形成新的学习算子。
simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.required_action: Replace the rule-library thesis with a formally certified learned transition abstraction or inductive invariant whose soundness, abstention behavior, and compositional transfer cannot be reproduced by AutoSpec, AgentSpec, or a capacity-matched rule learner.
simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.required_action_zh: 将规则库论文实质性改为具有形式化认证的学习型转移抽象或归纳不变量，并证明其可靠性、弃判行为和组合迁移能力无法被 AutoSpec、AgentSpec 或容量匹配的规则学习器复现。

closest_work.title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
Automating the Refinement of Reinforcement Learning Specifications

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Only the use of verified irreversible-action counterfactuals and explicit simulator-off transfer remains, and these are currently data-generation and evaluation choices rather than a standalone method.

simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.strongest_baseline: AutoSpec trained on exactly the same verified counterfactual traces and restricted to the same predicate vocabulary, program size, abstention budget, and runtime cost
simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.decisive_pilot: Generate one shared counterfactual trace set from an exact transition environment, train AutoSpec, a decision tree, a lookup-table shield, and the proposed typed synthesizer under the same predicate and program-size budget, disable the simulator, and evaluate unseen states plus transfer to a second transition system.
simulator-free-risk-program-distillation.stop_rule: Keep the work only as a component or benchmark if AutoSpec or a capacity-matched rule learner matches simulator-off safety and utility, if transfer requires manually remapping most predicates, or if the synthesized programs lack a stronger formal guarantee than empirical rule accuracy.
unknowns: The formal syntax and semantics of the typed risk-program language
Whether the transition verifier is sound and complete over generated substitutions
What synthesis algorithm differs from existing CEGIS or inductive logic programming
How state predicates and action consequences are aligned across the two transition systems
Whether abstention and conflicting-program resolution have formal guarantees

removable_atoms: verified counterfactual generation, because matched simulator rollouts or ordinary counterexample mining can supply equivalent labeled traces
simulator-off freeze, because it is a deployment and evaluation constraint rather than a learning mechanism
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: AutoSpec or a decision-tree rule learner trained on the identical simulator-generated safe and unsafe traces, then executed with the simulator disabled
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The proposal coherently generates risk evidence, synthesizes persistent programs, and evaluates them after simulator removal, but this is the established counterexample-guided rule-synthesis loop rather than a new composition.

workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.finding: The deployment failure is real and the proposed library is an exact persistent update object, but the current composition is not yet isolated from existing failure-driven workflow and harness repair. Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement already mines concentrated failure signatures and applies constrained graph edits, while HarnessFix consolidates recurring diagnoses into scoped repair operators. Frozen transfer is an evaluation boundary rather than a necessary learning atom. A standalone contribution survives only if the method induces reusable structural rewrite templates across API-disjoint and motif-disjoint tasks without generating a fresh patch at test time.
workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.finding_zh: 该部署问题真实存在，重写模板库也是明确的持久更新对象，但当前组合尚未与已有的失败驱动工作流和智能体框架修复方法拉开边界。Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement 已从集中失败模式中执行受约束图编辑，HarnessFix 也会聚合重复诊断并生成局部修复算子。冻结迁移属于评测边界，而不是必要的学习机制。只有在禁止测试时重新生成补丁的情况下，证明方法能够跨 API 和跨结构故障类型归纳并复用重写模板，才构成独立贡献。
workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.required_action: Constrain the learned object to a fixed structural rewrite language and demonstrate frozen cross-API, cross-motif reuse against Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement, HarnessFix, and nearest-graph-diff retrieval with identical model-call and tool-call budgets.
workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.required_action_zh: 将学习对象限制为固定的结构重写语言，并在相同模型调用和工具调用预算下，与 Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement、HarnessFix 及最近图差分检索比较，证明冻结后能够跨 API、跨故障模式复用。

closest_work.title: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A persistent, fixed-language library of structural repair templates that is learned once and directly reused on API-disjoint and motif-disjoint workflows without test-time workflow search or patch synthesis.

workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.strongest_baseline: Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement augmented with nearest-neighbor retrieval of previously successful graph edits
workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.decisive_pilot: Partition 200 injected workflow faults simultaneously by API and structural motif family. Learn templates only on source partitions, freeze the library, and test unseen APIs plus unseen motif compositions against Failure-Driven Workflow Refinement, HarnessFix-style scoped repair, nearest-diff retrieval, and a fixed-operator ablation under matched calls, tokens, and traces.
workflow-failure-motif-rewriter.stop_rule: Stop the standalone method claim if generic constrained repair or nearest-diff retrieval matches held-out repair success within the confidence interval, if templates depend on API identifiers, or if no positive transfer appears on unseen motif compositions.
unknowns: Whether a public workflow graph extractor provides canonical graph diffs across the proposed environments.
Whether enough successful-neighbor traces exist for simultaneously API-disjoint and motif-disjoint splits.
Whether a fixed rewrite language can express the required repairs without embedding API-specific constants.

removable_atoms: frozen transfer
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Nearest-neighbor retrieval of successful graph diffs followed by a fixed typed graph-repair rule set
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Failure sensing and persistent updating are coherent, but credit from an individual failure to a reusable template is under-specified. Future evaluation does not distinguish reusable learning from per-instance repair unless all test-time patch generation is prohibited.

checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.finding: The problem of distinguishing real checkpoint progress from evaluation noise is important, but the specified persistent object is primarily an adaptive evaluation registry rather than a behavior-changing curriculum. Fluid Benchmarking, Item Response Scaling Laws, and Scales++ already cover efficient discriminative item selection or forecasting across changing model populations and checkpoints. Adjacent-checkpoint information gain can be implemented by paired IRT, and a fixed recency-decay model may replace the survival component. The proposal becomes a learning method only if its selected tasks causally improve subsequent checkpoints under a fixed training budget.
checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.finding_zh: 区分真实检查点进步与评测噪声是重要问题，但当前持久对象主要是自适应评测注册表，而不是能够改变模型行为的课程。Fluid Benchmarking、Item Response Scaling Laws 和 Scales++ 已覆盖面向变化模型或检查点的高效判别样本选择与性能预测。相邻检查点的信息增益可以由配对 IRT 实现，固定的时间衰减模型也可能替代生存模型。只有证明所选任务在固定训练预算下能够因果性地提升后续检查点，该方案才是学习方法而非评测方法。
checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.required_action: Close the training loop by using the frozen selector to allocate the next checkpoint's training examples and demonstrate causal held-out gains over paired IRT, learning-progress selection, fixed recency decay, and random curricula.
checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.required_action_zh: 闭合训练环路：用冻结后的选择器分配下一检查点的训练样本，并证明其相对配对 IRT、学习进度选择、固定时间衰减和随机课程能够带来因果性的留出性能提升。

closest_work.title: Fluid Language Model Benchmarking

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Causal use of checkpoint-discrimination and temporal-utility estimates to select training tasks that improve later checkpoints, rather than merely selecting evaluation probes.

checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.strongest_baseline: Paired IRT discrimination with learning-progress ranking and a fixed exponential half-life
checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.decisive_pilot: Use two genuine streams containing at least five sequential checkpoints. Fit selectors only on early rounds, then allocate identical numbers of training episodes to the proposed method, paired IRT, learning progress, and random selection before producing each later checkpoint. Evaluate both adjacent-version discrimination and independently held-out next-checkpoint capability.
checkpoint-discriminative-curriculum-lea.stop_rule: Stop the curriculum claim if the method improves probe efficiency but does not improve subsequent checkpoint behavior, if paired IRT with fixed decay matches future utility, or if results hold only on synthetic checkpoint streams.
unknowns: Availability of two genuine five-to-eight-round version streams with stable task semantics and task-level outcomes.
Whether selected evaluation tasks can be inserted into subsequent training rounds under controlled budgets.
How true capability trends will be labeled independently of the same probe registry used for selection.

removable_atoms: probe survival model
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Paired IRT item discrimination combined with exponential recency decay and learning-progress task selection
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Sensing and future evaluation are specified, but the update currently changes only the probe registry. There is no closed causal path from task selection to training of the next checkpoint and then to independently measured future behavior.

monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.finding: The revived proposal materially changes the learned object from free-text repair into monotone specialization of an executable applicability set. The frozen precondition lattice defines the legal hypothesis space, minimal counterexamples identify the boundary to exclude, and the positive-retention constraint prevents collateral deletion of valid regions. SkillAdaptor and SkillTracer perform localized skill repair, while GraSP uses typed preconditions and local graph operators, but none directly establishes minimal monotone narrowing of one persistent lesson with executable exception lineage and guaranteed retention testing. This is a defensible standalone operator if it outperforms generic symbolic rule learning under the same vocabulary and complexity budget.
monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.finding_zh: 该复活方案将学习对象从自由文本修复实质性地改为可执行适用集合的单调特化。冻结的前置条件格定义合法假设空间，最小反例确定需要排除的边界，正例保持约束则防止误删原本正确的区域。SkillAdaptor 和 SkillTracer 执行局部技能修复，GraSP 采用类型化前置条件和局部图算子，但它们均未直接实现带可执行异常谱系、经过保持性验证的单一持久规则最小单调收缩。若该算子在相同谓词词表和复杂度预算下优于通用符号规则学习，则可形成独立论文贡献。
monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.required_action: Freeze the executable predicate language before observing counterexamples and show that monotone specialization dominates capacity-matched ILP, decision-tree, and SkillAdaptor variants on the misuse-retention-rule-complexity Pareto frontier.
monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.required_action_zh: 在观察反例前冻结可执行谓词语言，并证明单调特化在误用率、正例保持率和规则复杂度的帕累托前沿上优于容量匹配的 ILP、决策树及 SkillAdaptor 变体。

closest_work.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Minimal monotone specialization of one persistent applicability set in a frozen executable hypothesis language, with explicit exception lineage and preservation tests for every unaffected positive region.

monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.strongest_baseline: SkillAdaptor constrained to the same predicate vocabulary together with a capacity-matched ILP rule learner
monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.decisive_pilot: In an executable-rule environment, freeze one typed predicate language, stream minimal counterexamples, and compare against ILP, decision trees, free-text repair, deletion, and SkillAdaptor using the same evidence and rule-complexity budget. Measure false applicability, retained-positive accuracy, edit size, and performance on unseen states and counterexample orders.
monotone-applicability-specializer-v4.stop_rule: Stop the standalone claim if a generic rule learner or same-vocabulary SkillAdaptor matches the misuse-retention-edit-size frontier, if new domains require adding predicates after seeing test failures, or if purportedly minimal edits do not alter frozen execution behavior.
unknowns: No cross-domain frozen predicate language with complete applicability ground truth is identified.
It is unclear whether minimal counterexamples can be generated without an oracle.
Equivalence to SkillAdaptor constrained to the same executable vocabulary has not been tested.

combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: A capacity-matched ILP or decision-tree rule learner over the identical typed predicates with post-hoc positive-retention validation
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: The loop is coherent: executable predicates sense applicability, minimal counterexamples identify erroneous regions, constrained edits persistently narrow the lesson, retained positives control regressions, and unseen-state execution measures future misuse and coverage.

typed-correction-skill-grammar.finding: Converting correction credit into a persistent executable grammar is a material revival, but the proposed combination is heavily bordered by existing work. ASI and NSI already induce reusable programmatic or logic-grounded skills, SkillGen verifies skill effects through controlled with-skill versus without-skill interventions, and REFLECT uses controlled replay to validate error attribution. Typed failure slots may reduce to manual labels, while a nearest retrieved repair program may reproduce the claimed recovery without grammar induction. The surviving thesis requires evidence that learned productions recombine on unseen failure compositions rather than storing one repair per observed trace.
typed-correction-skill-grammar.finding_zh: 将纠错信用转化为持久的可执行语法属于实质性复活，但该组合与已有工作高度接近。ASI 和 NSI 已归纳可复用的程序化或逻辑化技能，SkillGen 通过有技能与无技能的受控干预验证技能效果，REFLECT 则通过受控重放验证错误归因。类型化失败槽可能退化为人工标签，最近邻修复程序检索也可能在无需语法归纳的情况下复现恢复效果。剩余的独立命题必须证明语法产生式能够在未见失败组合上重新组合，而不是为每条训练轨迹存储一个修复。
typed-correction-skill-grammar.required_action: Demonstrate automatically induced failure slots and grammar-level compositional generalization against ASI, NSI, flat skill induction, and intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval under identical trajectories and inference budgets.
typed-correction-skill-grammar.required_action_zh: 在相同轨迹数据和推理预算下，与 ASI、NSI、扁平技能归纳及经干预验证的最近修复检索比较，证明失败槽能够自动归纳且语法具有组合泛化能力。

closest_work.title: Lifting Traces to Logic: Programmatic Skill Induction with Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis

direct_collision.surviving_difference: A correction-specific grammar whose productions are credited to necessary actions and systematically recombine across unseen failure compositions, tool domains, and backbone models.

typed-correction-skill-grammar.strongest_baseline: NSI or ASI program induction combined with intervention-verified nearest-repair retrieval
typed-correction-skill-grammar.decisive_pilot: Train on primitive correction types and only a strict subset of their pairwise compositions across two tool domains. Test held-out compositions and a second frozen model under matched traces, calls, and executable-skill capacity, comparing the full method with ASI, NSI, nearest-repair retrieval, flat natural-language skills, and an ablation without action-necessity interventions.
typed-correction-skill-grammar.stop_rule: Stop the grammar claim if it does not outperform retrieval or flat programmatic skills on unseen compositions, if failure slots require manual annotation, or if the number of productions grows approximately one-for-one with training traces.
unknowns: No independent automatic ground truth is specified for observation, plan, tool, and action failure slots.
It is unclear whether module-replacement interventions are executable and semantically comparable across both proposed domains and the second model.
The proposed environments may not provide unique or verifiably minimal correction-action sequences.

removable_atoms: typed failure slots
combination_audit.simplest_equivalent_baseline: Intervention-verified nearest repair-program retrieval using ASI- or NSI-style program induction without grammar productions
combination_audit.closed_failure_loop: Controlled replacements provide a plausible sensing and credit path, and the grammar is an exact persistent update. However, slot identifiability and production-level credit are unresolved, so future recovery may be attributable to case retrieval rather than grammar composition.
